title: Dementia Prediction using Synthetic Data and Advanced Optimization
summary: A machine learning project predicting dementia from clinical tabular features, using neural network classifiers tuned with Genetic Algorithm and Artificial Bee Colony optimization to address class imbalance and limited data. It calls SDV's TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) with a SingleTableMetadata object to generate synthetic patient records for augmenting the training set.
evidence: dementia.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import TVAESynthesizer' and 'tvae = TVAESynthesizer(metadata, enforce_min_max_values=True, ...)'
